goal: Rung 06: the quality ledger - CAPA PDSA lifecycle with automatic effectiveness grading at horizon, variance triage producing an investigation packet (an aid, never a verdict), and the three folds (line-of-sight, committee packet, survey binder) as pure functions of a tape with every claim linked to its evidence; executioner G-FOLD-DETERMINISM

desc: The CAPA PDSA lifecycle and the variance triage. Grading reads its DIRECTION from baseline vs target rather than assuming lower-is-better, because half these metrics improve upward and guessing produces a CAPA that grades itself green while getting worse; a non-numeric observation abstains; unmet returns to committee WITH the data attached and never closes, because closing is an Act and an Act crosses under a signature (law A5). The triage has exactly three axes - coverage, novelty, distortion - and deliberately no fourth for who was involved; its selftest asserts that absence by scanning the packet for person-shaped fields

The ledger's input is PRODUCED, not authored: 5,760 quality events built by running the 59 encoded checks over the synthetic world, plus the human layer (findings, variances, CAPAs, signatures) marked as role-authored. Also pushes the whole tape through the ported hash-chained product ledger and verifies the chain - the first time that port has been asked to carry the quality vocabulary, and it does

The three documents as pure functions of a tape: the monthly line-of-sight report, the QAPI committee packet, the survey binder. Four properties, each enforced: pure (no clock, no file, no environment), order-independent (sorted before counting, so simultaneous events may arrive in any order), every number carries grain + denominator + evidence (the renderer offers no function that can print a bare count), and imported numbers are marked as imported with an external evidence handle rather than quietly omitted (law B9). The binder's authority column is the crosswalk's byte-verified citation - the point where rung 05 pays rent

Rung 06's executioner: the lifecycle battery, then the same tape rendered twice byte-identical, then rendered from a tape whose simultaneous events were reordered - byte-identical again - then every table data row checked for an evidence handle, then the product tape's chain verified
